title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
仿佛一闪而过，但林枫确确实实的捕捉到了它的身影。【精灵：藤藤蛇】【性别：雌】【特性：唱反调】【资质：红色】【个体值：HP（23）攻击（21）特攻（24）防御（25）特防（24）速度（31）】【实力：12~18级】【技能：刀叶，青草搅拌器，大蛇瞪眼，藤鞭，寄生种子。】【介绍：这似乎是一只喜欢吃桃桃果的藤藤蛇？】【亲密度：5】【愉悦值：10】一只藤藤蛇？一只红色资质的藤藤蛇！还是一只唱反调的藤藤蛇！？林枫目光诧异了起来。虽说宝可梦是一种有着无限可能的生物，但对于大部分宝可梦的成长而言，先天上还是会有一定的限制。这种限制，根据【探查之言】给出的信息来看，分为白，绿，蓝，紫，红，金。越往后，宝可梦的成就也就越高，但这也只是相对而言。不是说，白色资质的宝可梦，就没有机会成长为顶尖实力的宝可梦！只是需要一定的机缘!这个机遇可能是极好的培育，也可能是极强的羁绊之力....“出来，偷吃了我的东西，还要躲起来吗？难道说，你是一个小偷？”林枫并没有第一时间去桃桃树后揪出它，而是运用常磐之力，将自己的意思转递过去。作为一名培育家，他很清楚藤藤蛇的性格。这是一种聪慧而又骄傲的宝可梦。在挑选训练家这方面，具有一定的选择性。树后的藤藤蛇刚开始还有些懵，但很快就脸红了起来。很显然，在这个人类露出来后，它意识到，这个荒弃的种植园并不是无主之地。想到这点后。它心甘情愿的走了出来。细长的身躯，青绿色的背部上，带着百合花一般的装饰，乳白色的腹部皮肤，在阳光下反射着光泽，即便是在现实世界，藤藤蛇的皮肤也光滑的像是玉石....它扭捏着细短的小手，低着头。“藤藤？？”（这是你的桃桃果树吗？）

有着常磐之力在，林枫能很轻易知道藤藤蛇话中的意思。“自然...”他似笑非笑的看着这只藤藤蛇，然后又若有所思的看向旁边掉落一地的桃桃果核，“看样子，你吃的桃桃果还不少呀。”“偷吃别人的东西，这可不是什么好习惯呀。”“藤藤...”（可是我不知道这是你的桃桃果树。）藤藤蛇更加不好意思了。它只是觉得这里的桃桃果比野外的桃桃果更加好吃一点而已。“腾腾...”（我去外面摘桃桃果赔给你吧！）林枫摇了摇头，“外面的桃桃果可比不上我家精心种植的桃桃果。”“这样吧，正好这些天，我要整理一下这个种植园，你得留下来干点活怎么样？”“藤藤？”藤藤蛇抬起了头，琥珀般的眼眸明亮中带着好奇的光芒。“就像这样，把里面的杂草拔光。”林枫做了一个表率，将身前的一颗杂草拔下来，然后放在路旁。“藤藤...”（好。）藤藤蛇心中松了一口气，它的性格，不允许它有偷盗的行为。“当然，这段时间的伙食，我包了。”见到藤藤蛇同意，林枫也露出了笑容。能在种植园的起步阶段，有个帮手，实在是再好不过了。至少....这些杂草，让他一个人来拔的话，恐怕需要两三天？而且，在种植这些农作物后，还需要一名得力的帮手守护。否则，泥土中有小拉达，天空上有烈雀。它们都会想法子吃掉你的种植物。藤藤蛇现在能答应自己的第一份“劳动合同”，后面自然会答应第二份！作为中级（划掉）神级培育家。林枫有这个自信，看着已经忙碌起来藤藤蛇，他点了点头，“你先拔，我去给你做一些能量方块。”“藤藤~”
content_en:
It seemed to flash by, but Lin Feng really captured its figure.[Elf: Vine Snake] [Gender: Female] [Characteristics: Rebellious] [Qualification: Red] [Individual Value: HP (23) Attack (21) Special Attack (24) Defense (25) Special Defense (24) Speed ​​(31)] [Strength: Level 12~18] [Skills: Blade, Grass Blender, Serpent Glare, Vine Whip, Parasitic Seed.】【Introduction: This seems to be a vine snake that likes to eat peach fruits?] [Intimacy: 5] [Pleasure value: 10] A vine snake?A red-qualified vine snake!还是一只唱反调的藤藤蛇！?Lin Feng's eyes became surprised.Although Pokémon are creatures with infinite possibilities, there are still certain innate limitations to the growth of most Pokémon.This kind of restriction, according to the information given in [Exploration Words], is divided into white, green, blue, purple, red, and gold.The further you go, the higher the Pokémon's achievements will be, but this is only a relative term.This does not mean that Pokémon with white qualifications have no chance to grow into top-notch Pokémon!It just requires a certain chance! This opportunity may be an excellent nurturing, or it may be a very strong bonding force... "You came out and stole my things, do you still have to hide? Could it be that you are a thief?" Lin Feng did not immediately go to the peach tree to pull it out, but used the power of Changpan to convey his meaning.As a breeder, he knows the character of the vine snake very well.这是一种聪慧而又骄傲的宝可梦。There is a certain degree of selectivity in selecting trainers.The vine snake behind the tree was a little confused at first, but soon turned red.Apparently, after the human was revealed, it realized that this abandoned plantation was not a deserted land.After thinking about this.It came out willingly.The slender body, the green back, is decorated like lilies, and the milky white belly skin reflects luster in the sun. Even in the real world, the skin of the Vine Snake is as smooth as jade... It twisted its short little hands and lowered its head."Vine??" (Is this your peach fruit tree?)

With the power of Changpan, Lin Feng could easily understand the meaning of Teng Teng Snake's words."Of course..." He looked at the vine snake with a half-smile, and then looked thoughtfully at the peach fruit cores that had fallen to the ground beside him. "It seems that you have eaten a lot of peaches and peaches." "It's not a good habit to steal other people's things." "Vine vine..." (But I didn't know this was your peach fruit tree.) The vine snake was even more embarrassed.It just thinks that the peach fruits here are more delicious than those in the wild."Tengteng..." (I'll go outside to pick peaches to compensate you!) Lin Feng shook his head, "The peaches outside are not as good as the peaches carefully grown at my home." "Well, just these days, I have to tidy up this plantation, how about you stay and do some work?" "Vine?" The Vine Snake raised its head, its bright amber eyes filled with curiosity."Just like this, pull out all the weeds inside." Lin Feng set an example by pulling out a weed in front of him and placing it by the roadside."Teng Teng..." (Okay.) The Teng Teng Snake breathed a sigh of relief. Its character did not allow it to steal."Of course, I'll cover the food for this period." Seeing Teng Teng Snake agree, Lin Feng also smiled.It would be great to have a helper in the beginning stages of a plantation.At least...if he were to pull out these weeds alone, it would probably take two or three days?Moreover, after planting these crops, they also need a capable helper to guard them.Otherwise, there are Rattadas in the dirt and Spearow in the sky.They will all try to eat your plants.藤藤蛇现在能答应自己的第一份“劳动合同”，后面自然会答应第二份！As an intermediate (crossed out) god-level cultivator.Lin Feng had this confidence. Looking at the vine snake that was already busy, he nodded, "You pull it out first, and I will make some energy cubes for you." "Vine~"
